opening.argument: The video presents a practical route to Facebook support: its title promises instructions for finding the support button and contacting chat support, and the speaker explains that viewers may need to install Messenger and log in to the Facebook app before locating the buttons. The visible Facebook help-centre page has a “Get support” control, while a later support panel offers “Chat with a representative.” Those screens fit the stated support-navigation purpose. An account chooser appears, but the described frames show no payment request, credential collection, or separate financial offer. The evidence supports an instructional reading without establishing a financial solicitation or an outcome beyond finding the support route.
